subject.title: [Feature]: Goal continuance — per-turn goal context + QA continuance scenarios

question: Should OpenClaw adopt bounded active-goal context as the permanent per-turn prompt contract for active `/goal` sessions, including post-compaction continuance QA?
rationale: This changes model-visible behavior across all active-goal sessions and the issue already carries protected maintainer/product-decision signaling, so automation should not settle the prompt contract by itself.

options.title: Adopt Bounded Per-Turn Goal Context
options.body: Proceed with the linked implementation direction after fixing delivery, ambient-event, and generated-doc blockers, while keeping inactive goals out of context.

options.title: QA-Only First
options.body: Add continuance scenarios that expose the current gap while deferring automatic active-goal injection to a later product decision.

options.title: Defer Automatic Continuance
options.body: Keep goals as explicit command/tool/TUI state for now and accept that users may need to steer later turns manually.

recommendation.title: Adopt Bounded Per-Turn Goal Context
recommendation.body: Proceed with the linked implementation direction after fixing delivery, ambient-event, and generated-doc blockers, while keeping inactive goals out of context.
